messages.subject: DT single selection server side
parts:
Wow!  DT is looking fantastic, I really like the new options of single and multiple selection.  http://rstudio.github.io/DT/shiny.html

Just a question, when on server side the 'single' selection is returning 'multiple' values in the foo_rows_selected, but I could have my code wrong.
Can you check?

## DT Server Side
# multi select is not suggested for server-side. when user changes page the seleced records are forgotten

library(shiny)
library(DT)
library(data.table)
ID=seq(1,nrow(mtcars))
data=data.table(ID,mtcars)
shinyApp(
    ui = fluidPage(
        title = 'Server-side processing of DataTables, with Scroller and Column Selector'
        ,fluidRow(uiOutput('info'))
        ,fluidRow(DT::dataTableOutput('tbl'))
        ,fluidRow(textOutput('log'))
        ,fluidRow(uiOutput('link'))
    ),
    server = function(input, output, session) {
        
        output$info=renderUI(h2('DT table Server Side'))
        
        output$tbl = DT::renderDataTable(
            datatable(data
                      ,server=TRUE
                      ,escape=FALSE
                      ,extensions = c('ColVis','Scroller') 
                      ,rownames = FALSE
                      ,selection='single'
                      ,filter = "bottom"  #filter must be at bottom if there is Scroller
                      ,options=list(
                          dom='iC<"clear">frtS'  
                          ,scrollX=TRUE
                          ,scrollY='400px'
                          ,searchHighlight=TRUE
                          ,ajax = list(url = dataTableAjax(rowname=FALSE, session, data))  #must be present if server side, must have the 'data' frame used for the table
                      )
            )
)
output$link=renderUI(a('Documentation',href='https://rstudio.github.io/DT/server.html'))
output$log=renderText(paste0('ID selected: ',paste(input$tbl_rows_selected,collapse=',')))
    }
)


Thanks!
Max

Sorry I was unable to take a look at this issue when you posted it,
which is too bad since we just released DT to CRAN. It is a bug and I
just fixed it in the development version of DT:
https://github.com/rstudio/DT Thanks!

Regards,
Yihui
